opennyai_summary.21_February_2023__decision:
This is an application under Section 438 of the CrPC seeking pre-arrest bail by the petitioners,
namely, 1. Sri Pradeep Kumar Agarwal and 2. Sri Sahil Agarwal in respect of Palashbari P.S. Case No. 5/2023 under Section 468/471/420 IPC.
Considering all the documents available on record, this court is of the opinion that the petitioners deserve to given an interim protection.
Accordingly, as an interim measure, it is hereby provided that in the event of arrest of the petitioners named above in connection with the aforesaid case, they shall be released on bail of Rs. 25,000/- each with one suitable surety each to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when called upon and co-operate with the investigation.
